description: Use this when the user asks whether one or more stocks are halal, Shariah-compliant or permissible for a Muslim investor. Takes 1 to 10 tickers or company names and shows invest-like's AAOIFI-based screen for each: halal, questionable or not halal, the reason in plain words, the business test and interest-bearing debt as a share of market value. A screen, not a fatwa.
name: check_halal
title: Check if stocks are halal
